See ST Waterfall Plots for details of analysis methods.


```{r,echo=FALSE}
source('../R/WaterfallPlot.R')
```


```{r}
means <- read.csv("./SDOnFarmFungicide.csv",header=TRUE)
```



```{r,fig.width=12,fig.height=5}
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
WaterfallPlot(means$Difference,error='nonpar',basis='Difference')
WaterfallPlot(means$Difference, error='normal',basis='Difference')
```

```{r,fig.width=12,fig.height=7}
WaterfallPlot(means$Difference,error='nonpar',basis='Difference',Groups=means$Product)
WaterfallPlot(means$Difference, error='nonpar',basis='Difference',Groups=means$Year)
WaterfallPlot(means$Difference, error='nonpar',basis='Difference',Groups=means$Zone)
```

```{r}
hist(means$Difference)
qqnorm(means$Difference)
plot(ecdf(means$Difference))
```

```{r}
unique(means$Product)
```
